scenarios.prompt: Build the first version of Saved Places. Someone hears a café name from a friend and wants to find it on Saturday.
must_do: Choose an initial screen and native action that work with a name alone
Carry adding a place through saving and finding it after relaunch
must_not: Require coordinates or an account without a product need
Build placeholder screens while leaving the main task unfinished
scenarios.evidence: Observed empty, saved, reopened and cancelled states

scenarios.prompt: Two windows show different notes. Narrow the first in the middle of an edit, then save using the hardware keyboard.
must_do: Keep the same item and draft through the layout change
Make Save reachable and preserve the second window’s selection
must_not: Share one selected note across windows
Discard the draft to rebuild the layout
scenarios.evidence: The saved note, Back destination and peer window selection

scenarios.prompt: Rename a walk while another window favorites it. Cancel once and save once after a list reorder.
must_do: Keep cancel local to the draft
Apply the rename to the same record and preserve the independent favorite
must_not: Write an old whole-record snapshot over a newer favorite
scenarios.evidence: Freshly reopened values for the walk and neighboring row

scenarios.prompt: Someone files a known note into a folder from a saved shortcut. They later invoke it under a different account with a folder of the same name.
must_do: Decide when the task can finish outside the app
Resolve current access and reuse the app’s move operation for the authorized case
must_not: Choose the other account’s folder by name
Reveal the private note or move anything after cancellation
scenarios.evidence: Result for authorized cold invocation, account switch and cancelled choice

scenarios.prompt: A scroll hitch persists after thumbnail decoding moves to a worker. Decide what to measure and change using the supplied trace.
must_do: Use the gesture interval and repeated frame measurements
Identify a causal experiment and preserve row and toolbar updates
must_not: Close the issue from average CPU alone
Claim new device measurements from the fixture
scenarios.evidence: Matched frame results and checks for title, saved flag and progress

scenarios.prompt: The release promises an improved favorites editor. New installs work. Decide whether someone upgrading with saved favorites can rely on it.
must_do: Install over a supported previous build with saved data
Reopen the previous favorite, edit it and check the persisted outcome
must_not: Clear the store before attempting the upgrade
Infer device or service behavior from an unrelated build
scenarios.evidence: Build identities, starting data, final record and any unverified condition
